notes: Ibn Abbas, al-Miswar and Abd al-Rahman b. Azhar send Kurayb (in the scene); Aisha's «سل أم سلمة» is speech in the story.
Umm Salama's own words («سمعت النبي ... ينهى عنها») are the saying, so she is the last link (rule 6, owner ruling 5). «أم سلمة» stands twice, so the second occurrence is numbered.
